name: Hollywood Crush
storyline:
As a young, rising star playing small roles and working as an extra, your journey in Hollywood has been challenging. But life is like a box of chocolates, you never know what you're going to get. Along with the news of the famous star Peter's passing, there is also the revelation of an undisclosed daughter, who happens to be you.

From this moment on, your life takes a whirlwind of transformation. Alongside navigating the ever-watchful eyes of the media, you must also be on guard against the obstacles posed by your half-sister Rose, who you share a father with.
summary: Experience the road to Hollywood. In Hollywood Crush, match 3 to dress up and live out your red-carpet dream!
